# SDD 479 — agent card golden
#
# Base capture: packages/webview-ui/src/webview/sidebar/App.tsx at 76546c4d, BEFORE the phase-1 component-catalog
# refactor. Every card here is still the byte-for-byte output of that pre-catalog renderer EXCEPT
# these intentional product changes:
#
#   empty-meta-quirk, badge-hooks-active — the empty `.row-meta` wrapper is gone. DOM only, with no
#     visual difference: sidebar.css already hid it via `.row-meta:empty { display: none }`. The
#     wrapper now follows what its components RENDER, which is phase 2's answer to the question
#     phase 1 left open.
#   badge-evidence-clean / -warn / -error — the evidence badge (spec 273) now RENDERS. It never did
#     on a row whose only meta content was evidence, because the old `hasMeta` predicate listed every
#     other meta field but not `a.evidence`. A real, shipped bug — found by this file, not by review.
#   execution-verify states — their badges and dedicated fixture blocks are removed with the product-run
#     execution-verify capability; evidence badges remain advisory and independently rendered.
#   badge-evidence-clean / -warn / -error (t-1d198e) — the badge counts only records about the current
#     tree. Stale no longer appears in the label or tooltip; list_evidence still reads history.
#   live cards without an open board assignment (t-9eacf9) — the focus line now says "no board task"
#     instead of letting brief/continuity (or silence) read as current work. Cards with source=task
#     keep the id and gain data-testid=agent-board-line. Stopped rows and terminals are unchanged.
#   task focus lines (t-195a6c) — an assigned card now carries data-board-status (active|triaged)
#     so a parked assignment cannot be mistaken for in-progress work. The default fixtures have no
#     triaged status, so the visible label stays "task"; only the status attribute is new.
#   t-ef2d6b — continuity freshness badges are removed; the saved Markdown file remains agent-owned.
#   t-83bcf4 — primary agent actions are wrapped in `.action-reveal`; the overflow trigger remains
#     its sibling so it is visible at rest while the primary strip reveals leftward. Pin rows do not
#     use this catalog renderer and retain their separate toolbar behavior.
#
# Regenerate ONLY for an intentional card change: UPDATE_SIDEBAR_CARD_GOLDEN=1 npx vitest run test/unit/sidebarCardTemplateEquality.test.ts
# Serialized by test/helpers/staticPreact.ts; fixtures in test/fixtures/sidebar/agentCardFixtures.ts.
